fileHeader.description: Three-axis pen plotter, CSP architecture. Reuses motion3axis FB stack verbatim (INTERP / DRIVE402 / MC API). Additions: INTERP_Z for the pen axis via parameterized INTERP (0..10mm, VMAX 20, POSWIN 1); 9-step CASE plotting sequencer (pen-up -> start (20,20) -> pen-down -> square edges -> pen-up -> center (50,50)); pen interlock - manual cmd_go/jog/home on X/Y requires pen_up (z_fb >= 8), Z lift always allowed, Z home position = 10 (pen up); out-of-range targets safely rejected by interpolators. prog_id = 2.
